description: Optional. Normalize survey enums and build the retrieval profile for writers other than the API.

script.source: def a = ctx.answers; def parts = new ArrayList(); if (a != null) { if (a.interests != null) { for (def i : a.interests) { parts.add(i); } } if (a.level != null) { parts.add(a.level); } if (a.goal != null && a.goal.length() > 0) { parts.add(a.goal.toLowerCase()); } } ctx.profile_text = String.join(' ', parts);
